rows.notes: The cited study is a narrative/exploratory literature review (title and Section 1 state it is a review with no defined protocol; no own data, experiments, surveys or model runs). It describes the WA+ framework (Section 3.1) only by citing IWMI/IHE-Delft and other work [55-57], and the statement that a common information base is a key output of water accounting is attributed to cited sources [21,22]. No primary result on remote sensing bridging data gaps or enhancing inter-agency coordination is reported.

notes: Study is a review article (Agronomy 2023, 13, 1938) that clarifies water accounting terminology and surveys measurement/estimation methods; it proposes indicator equations but reports no own empirical application. Text appears complete (pages 1-36 with some OCR duplication).
